boards.title: Your First Weekend at University of Illinois Chicago, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A flexible, under-21-safe sequence for getting oriented on UIC’s East Campus and sampling its public cultural and student spaces.

cards.title: Pin the campus starting point
cards.subtitle: Student Services Building, 1220 W. Harrison St.
cards.notes: Save the Visitors Center location before heading out, then use the nearby transit guidance to orient your first walk across East Campus.
cards.short_summary: A clearly identified campus gateway in the Student Services Building.
cards.evidence_claim: UIC Admissions identifies the UIC Visitor Center in the Student Services Building at 1220 West Harrison Street and notes Blue Line and bus service.
cards.source_title: Directions to Specific Buildings | UIC Admissions
cards.access_notes: Check an event registration confirmation for the most accurate arrival details.

cards.title: Walk through the UIC Quad
cards.subtitle: Between Lecture Center Buildings A–F
cards.notes: Use the Quad as a walking landmark: pause to identify the surrounding lecture centers, then choose your next destination from the campus map.
cards.short_summary: The central open space among UIC’s lecture centers.
cards.evidence_claim: UIC’s campus map states that the UIC Quad is located in the middle of Lecture Center Buildings A–F.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor campus space; use the interactive map for walking directions.

cards.title: Spot University Hall’s silhouette
cards.subtitle: 601 S. Morgan St.
cards.notes: Take an exterior look from the plaza and use the tower as a visual anchor while you learn the East Campus street grid.
cards.short_summary: UIC’s 28-story campus landmark on South Morgan Street.
cards.evidence_claim: UIC’s campus map describes University Hall at 601 South Morgan Street as a 28-story office tower and campus landmark.
cards.access_notes: Exterior viewing is the suggested activity; follow building-access rules for interior entry.

cards.title: Locate your library base
cards.subtitle: 801 S. Morgan St.
cards.notes: Find the service points and note the study-room reservation option so you have a practical return stop when coursework begins.
cards.short_summary: UIC’s main library, with reservable group study rooms.
cards.evidence_claim: UIC Library lists Richard J. Daley Library at 801 South Morgan Street and says group study rooms are available through online reservation.
cards.source_title: Richard J. Daley Library | UIC University Library
cards.access_notes: UIC’s library homepage currently notes that a UIC i-card is required for building access; check library hours before going.

cards.title: Make Student Center East your meetup point
cards.subtitle: 750 S. Halsted St.
cards.notes: Use the building’s lounges, dining areas, and meeting-space hub as an easy place to regroup before choosing an afternoon activity.
cards.short_summary: A central East Campus hub with dining, lounges, and meeting spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: UIC’s campus map says Student Center East contains recreation facilities, meeting rooms, lounge spaces, university offices, and main dining areas.
cards.access_notes: UIC currently lists regular Saturday–Sunday building hours as 6:30 a.m.–9 p.m.; confirm holiday or break changes.

cards.title: Add a low-key game at Millennium Lanes
cards.subtitle: Student Center East
cards.notes: If your group wants a structured activity, check lane availability and choose bowling or billiards; verify the posted schedule before arriving.
cards.short_summary: UIC’s eight-lane bowling center inside Student Center East.
cards.evidence_claim: UIC Student Centers describes Millennium Lanes as an eight-lane bowling center and publishes bowling and billiards rates.
cards.access_notes: UIC lists summer weekend bowling and billiards hours as noon–9 p.m.; hours and closures vary by term.

cards.title: Check out the recreation options
cards.subtitle: 737 S. Halsted St.
cards.notes: Walk by the facility to locate it, then review the current recreation schedule or membership details before planning a later workout.
cards.short_summary: UIC’s East Campus recreation facility on South Halsted Street.
cards.evidence_claim: UIC Recreation and Wellbeing lists the Student Recreation Facility at 737 South Halsted Street and offers facility programs and services.
cards.source_title: Recreation and Wellbeing | University of Illinois Chicago
cards.access_notes: Registered fee-paying UIC students have facility access; other students may need a membership. Check current facility hours before entry.

cards.title: Spend Saturday with campus history
cards.subtitle: 800 S. Halsted St.
cards.notes: Plan this stop for Saturday, browse the current exhibition, and leave time to read the historic site’s interpretation rather than rushing through.
cards.short_summary: A National Historic Landmark museum on UIC’s East Campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The Jane Addams Hull-House Museum identifies itself as a National Historic Landmark at 800 South Halsted Street and lists free admission.
cards.access_notes: Current museum hours list Saturday 10 a.m.–3 p.m.; it is closed Sunday and Monday.

cards.title: See what’s on at Gallery 400
cards.subtitle: Art and Exhibition Hall, 400 S. Peoria St.
cards.notes: Check the exhibition schedule first, then make a Saturday gallery visit part of your campus loop and allow time for the current installation.
cards.short_summary: UIC’s public contemporary-art gallery in Art and Exhibition Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: Gallery 400 states that it is in Art and Exhibition Hall at 400 South Peoria Street and that admission is free and open to all.
cards.access_notes: Current listed Saturday hours are noon–5 p.m.; the gallery may close during installations or holidays, so review its exhibition schedule.

cards.title: End by locating UIC Theatre
cards.subtitle: 1044 W. Harrison St.
cards.notes: Walk past the theater to place it on your campus mental map, then consult the performing-arts calendar before committing to a future show.
cards.short_summary: UIC’s 250-seat black-box theater on West Harrison Street.
cards.evidence_claim: UIC’s campus map identifies UIC Theatre at 1044 West Harrison Street as a 250-seat black-box theater that presents four shows per season.
cards.access_notes: This card suggests an exterior orientation stop; consult the performing-arts calendar for show dates, ticketing, and entry details.
